name: A group of dwellings fashioned from Tanka boats
summary: The adapted boat-dwelllings are covered with the semicircular rattan coverings that earned these craft the description of 'egg-boats'.  On the left is a fisherman with his boat; among the dwellings are boatwomen (one on a ladder) and chickens.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
